audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers of the level chart disagree on all seven rows. Full layer reads Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Syndra/Skill/Syndra; content win[0..6] reads Syndra/Syndra/Syndra/Syndra/Aurora/Aurora/Aurora, which is exactly the packet levelChart.
audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] render the same row. Packet levelChart and the content prose agree with each other and with the whole page's story (Syndra zones pre-6, Aurora flips at Between Worlds), and the 48.93% owner win rate fits a lane Aurora has to survive first.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side set to Syndra, phases[4..6].side set to Aurora, ratings re-scaled to the page's own convention (higher = harder for Aurora), and every affected why rewritten in the same proposal so the sentence argues the same side as the row.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..3].why all described Aurora winning the early levels while the row itself was about to be given to Syndra, and they were generic Aurora boilerplate ('Q-poke and recast on his last-hits', 'W online', 'E completes the trade loop') with no Syndra content.
audit.why: Syndra's early dominance is mechanical: Dark Sphere is a flat 7-second cooldown at every rank against Aurora's 9s Q, Force of Will reaches 925 against Aurora's 900 Q, and Splinters of Wrath widen Scatter the Weak. Aurora's spike is Between Worlds at 6 against a champion with no dash.
audit.corrected: Early whys rewritten around Dark Sphere's flat 7s, Force of Will's 925 range, and the Splinters upgrade; the level 6 and later whys rewritten around Syndra having no dash to escape Between Worlds.
sources: enemyKit Q cd 7 / W range 925 / P text

audit.whatIsWrong: Scatter the Weak was described as a 'QE stun cone' that stuns anyone on the line. Riot's text: it knocks enemies AND Dark Spheres back, and only enemies hit by a Dark Sphere are stunned. The page also never mentioned Force of Will's true damage or Unleashed Power's execute.
audit.why: The decisive interaction is that the stun requires a sphere between her and you — break that line and E is only a knockback. Transcendent adds bonus true damage to Force of Will and an execute to Unleashed Power, so stacking MR is the wrong answer and a low health bar is a kill number, not a cushion.
audit.corrected: report[5].t now states the sphere-line requirement and the flat 15s cooldown; breakdown.cooldowns carries the real numbers; enemyWin, breakdown.feeding and itemization now carry the true damage and execute facts from missingInteractions.

audit.why: It is the field that is supposed to hold real cooldowns, and Syndra's are unusually clean to quote because two of them are flat at every rank.
audit.corrected: Scatter the Weak flat 15s, Dark Sphere flat 7s, Force of Will 12s at rank 1, Across the Veil 22s at rank 1.

audit.why: 48.93% Emerald+ over 2569 games, consistent with a lane Aurora loses early and wins after 6.
